messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Sev2: Streaming SLO breach detected for /v1/stream (p99 > 3s) — dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/12345 :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: I'm on it. starting triage, pulling logs and tracing. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.

alice (eng-runtime): I see a big tail spike for streaming endpoints since 16:03 UTC. p95 ~1.1s, p99 ~6.7s. throughput same as normal. looks like chunking/stall not model compute.

bob (eng-platform): nginx ingress shows a bunch of 502/504 / upstream prematurely closed connection and proxy_buffering timed out. sample:```
2025-11-18T16:04:12Z nginx[ingress]: 502 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream
2025-11-18T16:04:18Z nginx[ingress]: 504 upstream read timeout, client: 10.1.2.3, server: stream-service
```

carol (sre): Reproduced locally with a slow client simulator — small read window causes the origin to accumulate data in kernel buffers -> runtime stalls on kv cache flush. Also seeing large TLS write backpressure on the proxy.

alice (eng-runtime): Two hypotheses: 1) proxy buffering + connection limits causing head-of-line blocking for streaming responses. 2) client backpressure (slow-read clients) building up and stalling server flushes. Both can cause tail latency.

ryan (pm): Which customers are impacted? cs-lead, can you pull active sessions list?

cs-lead: We have 4 paying customers with active streams right now. One enterprise account reported UI “stuck loading” at 16:05. Opening a support DM.

oncall-sre: Live mitigation plan step 1 -> reduce proxy buffering, step 2 -> route new streaming requests to fallback model variant (lower token throughput), step 3 -> temporary rate-limit long-lived streams to protect headroom. Applying step 1 now.

carol (sre): Patch to ingress (nginx) suggestion: set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_read_timeout 120; proxy_send_timeout 120;` will unblock flushes. Also set `proxy_buffers 4 16k; proxy_busy_buffers_size 32k;` to limit memory.

alice (eng-runtime): On runtime side we can lower the max-concurrency per worker and reduce per-stream mem usage. Also enable aggressive KV flush interval to avoid big cache churn: config flag `--kv-flush-ms=50` for streaming pods.

bob (eng-platform): I'm applying the nginx ingress patch to the staging ingress and will roll to prod to one AZ first. Command I'm using:```kubectl -n ingress patch configmap nginx-ingress -p '{"data":{"proxy-buffering":"off","proxy-http-version":"1.1","chunked-transfer-encoding":"on"}}'```Rolling a single ingress controller pod.```kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deployment/nginx-ingress-controller --selector=zone=us-west-2a```

oncall-sre: Applying step 2 now — updating traffic rule to send new /v1/stream requests to model-variant: rwd-small-2025. This is a traffic split, not a config change. Should be immediate.

alice (eng-runtime): Pushed runtime flag to streaming deployment: `--kv-flush-ms=50 --max-concurrency=8` for canary.

carol (sre): Observability note: enabling the ingress log flags for upstream_write_time and upstream_response_time. Also increased sampling from 1% to 10% for streaming traces for the next 20 minutes.

10m later...

oncall-sre: metrics update: p99 dropped from 6.7s -> 1.9s after ingress patch + canary runtime changes. Errors (502/504) decreased by ~85%.

bob (eng-platform): Canary ingress looks healthy; rolling patch to other AZs now. Command: `kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deployment/nginx-ingress-controller --selector=zone!=us-west-2a`

cs-lead: Customer who reported UI issue confirmed recovery. They saw ~2-3 failed reconnects.

ryan (pm): Good mitigation. Next: root cause analysis + permanent fix plan. Possible long-term fixes: 1) change default proxy buffering behavior for streaming routes, 2) enforce client slow-read apis via token-level quotas and shorter idle timeouts, 3) streaming backpressure signals from runtime to proxy (tcp cork/flush tuning).

alice (eng-runtime): Follow-ups I'm tracking: - add runtime metric for stalled-chunks - add graceful degrade to smaller model when connection idle > X ms - add explicit flush heartbeat on streaming frames.

carol (sre): Platform follow-ups: - update ingress defaults for streaming traffic - add runbook entry for streaming stalls - set automated canary to route newly failing streams to fallback variant.

oncall-sre: escalation/handoff: I'm handing off to carol for postmortem. oncall ends shift in 20m. Creating incident ticket: INC-2025-4872 and linking to thread.

carol (sre): Ack. I'll run the postmortem and coordinate customer communications with Ryan and CS. If anyone has logs/samples of slow-client IPs, drop them here.

bob (eng-platform): One more datapoint — ELB metrics show increased active connections per instance at the time of spike, and a queue depth increase in tcp_moderate_rcvbuf. Adding a note to infra tuning doc.

oncall-sre: Final note before handoff: temporary mitigations achieved target and SLOs are back within thresholds (p99 < 2s). Closing on-call alert. Will follow up in postmortem with timeline and action items. :white_check_mark:

carol (sre): Logged follow-ups in INC-2025-4872 -> action items pinned. Opening a PR for ingress defaults after triage review.

ryan (pm): Thanks all. I'll draft the customer-facing summary and coordinate with CS.

cs-lead: I'll update affected customers with the summary and any recommended client-side changes.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-4872 created and assigned to carol. Slack thread archived to incidents channel.
